extras: Part of the Vault CMS project.
intentEvidence: Disables the ability to open multiple tabs, enforcing a single-tab interface.
problem: Users who prefer a simplified, single-view interface or who hide the tab bar need a way to prevent multiple tabs from cluttering the view.

relations.evidence: Particularly useful when hiding the tab bar with the Hider plugin.

summary: Enforces a single-tab interface by preventing the opening of multiple tabs in Obsidian, replacing the current tab with any new one.
